<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700&family=Tajawal:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --gold: #DCA95C;
    --gold-light: #e8c07a;
    --gold-dark: #b8872a;
    --white: #FFFFFF;
    --terra: #BF7A54;
    --bg: #0a0a0a;
    --card-bg: #111111;
    --border: rgba(220,169,92,0.25);
  }
  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--white); font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif; min-height:100vh; }

  .hero {
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0a0a0a 0%,#1a1308 50%,#0a0a0a 100%);
    padding:60px 40px 50px; text-align:center; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .hero::before {
    content:''; position:absolute; top:-100px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
    width:600px; height:600px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(220,169,92,0.08) 0%,transparent 70%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero-pattern {
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,transparent,transparent 30px,rgba(220,169,92,0.03) 30px,rgba(220,169,92,0.03) 31px);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .logo-wrap {
    width:150px; height:150px; margin:0 auto 22px;
    border:2px solid var(--gold); border-radius:8px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    position:relative; z-index:1;
    box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(220,169,92,0.3); overflow:hidden;
  }
  .logo-wrap img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }

  .brand-name {
    font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif; font-size:2.8rem; font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:0.05em; color:var(--gold); position:relative; z-index:1;
    text-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(220,169,92,0.4);
  }
  .brand-name-en {
    font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:1rem;
    color:rgba(220,169,92,0.5); letter-spacing:0.2em; display:block;
    margin-top:4px; position:relative; z-index:1;
  }
  .brand-divider {
    width:120px; height:1px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);
    margin:18px auto; position:relative; z-index:1;
  }
  .brand-tag { font-size:0.85rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4); position:relative; z-index:1; }

  .nav-wrapper {
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:100;
    background:rgba(10,10,10,0.97); backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); overflow-x:auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; scrollbar-width:none;
  }
  .nav-wrapper::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .nav-tabs {
    display:flex; gap:0; flex-direction:row;
    padding:0 20px; min-width:max-content;
  }
  .nav-tab {
    padding:14px 18px; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600;
    color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4); cursor:pointer;
    border-bottom:2px solid transparent; transition:all 0.25s ease;
    white-space:nowrap; background:none; border-top:none; border-left:none; border-right:none;
    font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif;
  }
  .nav-tab:hover{color:var(--gold-light)}
  .nav-tab.active{color:var(--gold);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}

  .main{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:50px 20px 80px}

  .section{display:none;animation:fadeUp 0.4s ease}
  .section.active{display:block}
  @keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

  .section-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-direction:row-reverse;margin-bottom:36px}
  .section-icon{
    width:44px;height:44px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold-dark),var(--gold));
    border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-size:1rem;flex-shrink:0;color:#000;font-weight:700;font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  }
  .section-title{font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif;font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
  .section-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(270deg,var(--gold-dark),transparent)}

  .items-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:14px}
  .item-card{
    background:var(--card-bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;
    padding:18px 20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;
    flex-direction:row-reverse;gap:14px;transition:border-color 0.2s,transform 0.2s;
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .item-card::before{
    content:'';position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:3px;height:100%;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),var(--terra));opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.2s;
  }
  .item-card:hover{border-color:rgba(220,169,92,0.5);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .item-card:hover::before{opacity:1}


  .item-img {
    width: 80px; height: 70px; flex-shrink: 0;
    border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden;
    background: #1e1e1e; border: 1px dashed rgba(220,169,92,0.3);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .item-img img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; border-radius:6px; }
  .item-img .ph {
    font-size:0.6rem; color:rgba(220,169,92,0.35);
    font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif; text-align:center; line-height:1.4; padding:4px;
  }
  .item-img {
    width:80px; height:70px; flex-shrink:0;
    border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden;
    background:#1a1a1a; border:1px dashed rgba(220,169,92,0.3);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .item-img img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; border-radius:6px; display:block; }
  .item-img .ph {
    font-size:0.58rem; color:rgba(220,169,92,0.3);
    font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif; text-align:center; line-height:1.5; padding:6px; user-select:none;
  }
  .item-info{flex:1;text-align:right}
  .item-name{font-size:0.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:4px;line-height:1.5}
  .item-name-en{font-size:0.7rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.25);font-family:'Playfair Display',serif}
  .item-price{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:0.95rem;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left}
  .item-price.range{font-size:0.78rem}

  .footer{
    text-align:center;padding:40px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
    color:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);font-size:0.8rem;
  }
  .footer span{color:var(--gold);opacity:0.6}

  @media(max-width:600px){
    .brand-name{font-size:2rem}
    .items-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  }
</style>
</head>

const navEl = document.getElementById('navTabs');
const mainEl = document.getElementById('mainContent');

menuData.forEach((cat, i) => {
  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.className = 'nav-tab' + (i===0?' active':'');
  btn.textContent = cat.label;
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById(cat.id).classList.add('active');
    btn.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest',inline:'center'});
  });
  navEl.appendChild(btn);

  const sec = document.createElement('section');
  sec.className = 'section'+(i===0?' active':'');
  sec.id = cat.id;
  sec.innerHTML = `
    <div class="section-header">
      <div class="section-icon">${cat.icon}</div>
      <h2 class="section-title">${cat.label}</h2>
      <div class="section-line"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="items-grid">
      ${cat.items.map(it=>`
        <div class="item-card">
          <div class="item-img">
            ${it.img ? `<img src="${it.img}" alt="${it.a}">` : '<div class=\"ph\">+ صورة</div>'}
          </div>
          <div class="item-info">
            <div class="item-name">${it.a}</div>
            <div class="item-name-en">${it.e}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="item-price ${it.r?'range':''}">${it.p} د.ع</div>
        </div>`).join('')}
    </div>`;
  mainEl.appendChild(sec);
});
</script>
